purpose: Verify the role-conditioned producer discovery surfaces Zint for the fresh plain barcode goal before supplier probing.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_apt_packages('encode barcode',limit=24)
hits=[x for x in out['candidates'] if x.get('name')=='zint']
print(json.dumps({'zint':hits,'top':out['candidates'][:8]},sort_keys=True))
assert hits, 'ZINT_NOT_DISCOVERED'
print('ROLE_CONDITIONED_ZINT_DISCOVERED')
PY
